correctness.rationale: For each real input, rowwise selection of one of three balls gives an exact max over 243 nonnegative matrices. An exact rational LDL certificate shows strict spectral gap below 1463/1000 for 238 choices. The remaining five are rotations, and their reflection-invariant Perron eigenspace yields the cubic 225t^3-390t^2+91t-4. Rational root isolation, strict activation checks, and Perron simplicity establish both the norm and the complete sign/rotation extremizers. Standalone Python replay succeeded.

originality.rationale: Soria and Tradacete (2014) formulate finite-graph maximal norms, but inspected sections cover general p <= 1 bounds and special stars/complete graphs, not this C5 strong ell-two norm. Gonzalez-Riquelme and Madrid (2020) calculate strong ell-two norms on stars and complete graphs, not C5. An accessible older four-cycle calculation has different operators and spectral certificates and cannot imply this new five-cycle cubic. Results from published semantic searches are not equivalent or stronger statements. A broad unpublished/unindexed priority risk remains.

value.rationale: The odd five-cycle is the smallest noncomplete odd cycle and a natural diameter-two graph outside special star and complete graph norm theorems. Its mixed three-radius norming pattern, nontrivial algebraic sharp constant and full extremizer rigidity provide a motivated exact strong-type invariant rather than arbitrary finite numerics.
